name: Deep Breath
source:
Deep Breath is a non-linear homoerotic visual novel that takes inspiration from classic fantasy world adventures. We follow Therion's life and choose one of many paths that revolve around the people in his life; or people who are about to enter it. Although, feel free to take them all with you.

A decade has passed since you've managed to escape a fate that the rest of your tribe could not. Your day to day life as a guild member becoming harder and harder to maintain as something continues to claw at your conscious every time a violent urge controls your action. And while that's going on, everyone gives you an exceptionally hard time. 

[From [url=https://ibytepng.itch.io/deep-breath]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《深呼吸》是一部非线性同性视觉小说，其灵感来自经典的奇幻世界冒险。我们跟随塞里昂的一生，并选择围绕他生命中的人们的众多道路之一；或即将进入其中的人。不过，请随意携带它们。

十年过去了，你已经成功逃脱了部落其他成员无法逃脱的命运。你作为公会成员的日常生活变得越来越难以维持，因为每当暴力冲动控制你的行动时，就会有某种东西继续抓住你的意识。当这种情况发生时，每个人都会给你带来异常困难的时期。

[来自[url=https://ibytepng.itch.io/deep-breath]Itch.io[/url]]
